messages.content: You are one member of a parallel architecture inquiry. Return only the contracted JSON. Produce executable mechanisms, APIs, state transitions, and verification rules; do not propose organizational process or prose-only governance.

Evidence: 84 Claude sessions in five days manually performed environment diagnosis, repository archaeology, architecture reconstruction, research synthesis, Lean proof work, refactors, tests, memory/skill creation, and repeated failure analysis. A transcript audit counted 2,067 direct mutations versus 190 subagent dispatches and about 30% human corrections. Prior harness research specifies carrier adapters with zero substrate intelligence, append-only prompt/tool/result capture, projected memory/context, deterministic tools, governed consolidation only after results, session heartbeats, work claim/settle, and context-compaction continuity. The existing free-compute-dev seed has deterministic resolver -> context -> model edit -> apply -> test -> feedback rounds -> expensive escalation, but only one task and no autonomous intake/decomposition/fanout/tool navigation/isolation/integration/memory. The existing LISS cheapest-sufficient fabric just demonstrated 24/24 schema-verified jobs at 24.45 useful jobs/min across Gemini and GitHub Models, with OpenRouter fallback and Claude available. Future volunteer CPU/GPU endpoints can join over Tailscale. The target is a Union-owned software-production fabric that receives territories/problems and keeps observing, decomposing, executing, verifying, integrating, and learning without a Codex or Claude conversation carrying the work.

Your bounded question: Design promotion from repeated verified model trajectories into deterministic scripts/resolvers/skills, with an objective trigger and regression evidence.

State what is absent from the current seed, give a concrete design, and name a smallest real vertical slice.

completion.text: {"component":"Trajectory Promotion Engine","absentMechanism":"The seed captures append-only prompt/tool/result sequences per session but discards them at session end. There is no cross-session trajectory fingerprinting, no clustering of structurally identical model output sequences, no extraction pipeline converting repeated verified sequences into deterministic resolvers, no shadow-run gate comparing an extracted function against a live model, and no regression corpus generated from promotion evidence. Every verified solution is relearned from scratch; structural repetition accumulates no capital.","design":["Append every completed tool-call sequence as a TrajectoryRecord {task_type_tag, context_schema_hash, [(tool_name, arg_shape_hash, result_schema_hash)...], verified:bool} to an immutable JSON-Lines trajectory store keyed by session-id. No deletion ever; compaction only appends a summary pointer.","Cluster records by structural_fingerprint = xxHash64(tool_name sequence + arg_shape_hash sequence, literals stripped). Cluster insert is O(1) via bloom-filter pre-check then exact bucket append. A record belongs to exactly one cluster.","Emit PromotionCandidate when cluster satisfies all three: size >= N_threshold (default 5), verified_fraction >= 0.90, inter-trajectory step-count standard deviation <= 1.0. Trigger evaluates on every insert; candidate is idempotent if already PENDING.","Extract invariant: token-level diff across all N trajectories; identical-across-all positions become hardcoded steps; variant positions become typed parameters. Output is a ResolverScript: a YAML tool-call template with parameter bindings and a JSON Schema for each parameter.","Shadow phase: transition skill to SHADOW for K_shadow=10 invocations. Script and fresh model call both execute; compare result_schema_hash. If divergence_rate < 0.05 over all K_shadow runs, transition to potential. Otherwise emit DemotionEvent and route to model.","Regression corpus: the N promotion trajectories plus every matched SHADOW-phase pair are locked as regression cases with context_schema_hash and environment_schema_hash. CI gate: a skill whose pass-rate drops below 0.95 is immediately demoted, state written atomically before any routing change.","Demotion is non-destructive: DEMOTED skills remain in store. If the same task_type cluster gains 3 more verified trajectories diverging from the demoted script by more than 2 steps, a new independent extraction run is triggered."],"firstVerticalSlice":["Select task_type 'env_diagnosis' as the target — highest-frequency trajectory class evidenced by 84 sessions. Manually label 5 already-captured session transcripts as verified env_diagnosis TrajectoryRecords and write them into a seed trajectory store.","Implement TrajectoryRecord schema (JSON Schema, strict) and append-to-file store. Verify round-trip: write 5 records, read them back, assert schema validation passes on all 5.","Write the structural fingerprinter as a pure function: strip literal values from tool arguments, hash the remaining shape sequence with xxHash64. Unit-test against the 5 seed records to confirm all 5 map to the same bucket.","Run the extractor on the 5 seed records to produce env_diagnosis_v1.yaml with 3-4 variant parameter fields (repo_path, expected_tool_list, os_marker). Confirm the YAML validates against the ResolverScript schema and replaying it reproduces each seed record's result_schema_hash.","Wire env_diagnosis_v1.yaml into the existing resolver: if task_type == 'env_diagnosis' and skill state == ACTIVE, execute the script and skip model routing. Log each invocation result to the trajectory store as a new TrajectoryRecord.","After 10 live invocations, compute divergence_rate versus held-out model runs on identical inputs. Accept promotion if divergence_rate < 0.05; otherwise record failing cases as regression seeds for the next extraction iteration."],"failureModes":["Over-promotion on surface structure: trajectories share tool-name sequence but solve subtly different subtasks, diverging on distribution shift. Mitigation: require context_schema_hash match as a secondary cluster key alongside structural_fingerprint.","Parameter extraction explosion: variant positions span deeply nested objects, producing unbounded parameter arity. Mitigation: cap max_parameter_count at 8; reject PromotionCandidate if extraction exceeds the cap and log as UNEXTRACTABLE.","Shadow-phase model degradation: model degrades between promotion trigger and shadow window, making the script appear better than warranted. Mitigation: shadow against N_shadow independent fresh model invocations, not the triggering session.","Corpus staleness on environment drift: new OS or API revision invalidates the promotion corpus silently. Mitigation: include environment_schema_hash in regression keys; a hash mismatch on replay triggers re-verification rather than a silent pass.","Demotion race: skill transitions to DEMOTED while an in-flight SHADOW invocation is still executing. Mitigation: state transitions are atomic file-rename operations; in-flight invocations check state at result-write time and discard if DEMOTED."],"successMetric":"After 10 ACTIVE invocations of a promoted skill, divergence_rate versus fresh model output for the same task_type is below 0.05, median wall-clock latency is at least 40% lower than a baseline model call on identical input, and zero regression cases added since promotion have failed their result_schema_hash assertion."}

structured_output.absentMechanism: The seed captures append-only prompt/tool/result sequences per session but discards them at session end. There is no cross-session trajectory fingerprinting, no clustering of structurally identical model output sequences, no extraction pipeline converting repeated verified sequences into deterministic resolvers, no shadow-run gate comparing an extracted function against a live model, and no regression corpus generated from promotion evidence. Every verified solution is relearned from scratch; structural repetition accumulates no capital.
design: Append every completed tool-call sequence as a TrajectoryRecord {task_type_tag, context_schema_hash, [(tool_name, arg_shape_hash, result_schema_hash)...], verified:bool} to an immutable JSON-Lines trajectory store keyed by session-id. No deletion ever; compaction only appends a summary pointer.

Cluster records by structural_fingerprint = xxHash64(tool_name sequence + arg_shape_hash sequence, literals stripped). Cluster insert is O(1) via bloom-filter pre-check then exact bucket append. A record belongs to exactly one cluster.

Emit PromotionCandidate when cluster satisfies all three: size >= N_threshold (default 5), verified_fraction >= 0.90, inter-trajectory step-count standard deviation <= 1.0. Trigger evaluates on every insert; candidate is idempotent if already PENDING.

Extract invariant: token-level diff across all N trajectories; identical-across-all positions become hardcoded steps; variant positions become typed parameters. Output is a ResolverScript: a YAML tool-call template with parameter bindings and a JSON Schema for each parameter.

Shadow phase: transition skill to SHADOW for K_shadow=10 invocations. Script and fresh model call both execute; compare result_schema_hash. If divergence_rate < 0.05 over all K_shadow runs, transition to potential. Otherwise emit DemotionEvent and route to model.

Regression corpus: the N promotion trajectories plus every matched SHADOW-phase pair are locked as regression cases with context_schema_hash and environment_schema_hash. CI gate: a skill whose pass-rate drops below 0.95 is immediately demoted, state written atomically before any routing change.

Demotion is non-destructive: DEMOTED skills remain in store. If the same task_type cluster gains 3 more verified trajectories diverging from the demoted script by more than 2 steps, a new independent extraction run is triggered.
firstVerticalSlice: Select task_type 'env_diagnosis' as the target — highest-frequency trajectory class evidenced by 84 sessions. Manually label 5 already-captured session transcripts as verified env_diagnosis TrajectoryRecords and write them into a seed trajectory store.
Implement TrajectoryRecord schema (JSON Schema, strict) and append-to-file store. Verify round-trip: write 5 records, read them back, assert schema validation passes on all 5.

Write the structural fingerprinter as a pure function: strip literal values from tool arguments, hash the remaining shape sequence with xxHash64. Unit-test against the 5 seed records to confirm all 5 map to the same bucket.

Run the extractor on the 5 seed records to produce env_diagnosis_v1.yaml with 3-4 variant parameter fields (repo_path, expected_tool_list, os_marker). Confirm the YAML validates against the ResolverScript schema and replaying it reproduces each seed record's result_schema_hash.

Wire env_diagnosis_v1.yaml into the existing resolver: if task_type == 'env_diagnosis' and skill state == ACTIVE, execute the script and skip model routing. Log each invocation result to the trajectory store as a new TrajectoryRecord.

After 10 live invocations, compute divergence_rate versus held-out model runs on identical inputs. Accept promotion if divergence_rate < 0.05; otherwise record failing cases as regression seeds for the next extraction iteration.
failureModes: Over-promotion on surface structure: trajectories share tool-name sequence but solve subtly different subtasks, diverging on distribution shift. Mitigation: require context_schema_hash match as a secondary cluster key alongside structural_fingerprint.

Parameter extraction explosion: variant positions span deeply nested objects, producing unbounded parameter arity. Mitigation: cap max_parameter_count at 8; reject PromotionCandidate if extraction exceeds the cap and log as UNEXTRACTABLE.

Shadow-phase model degradation: model degrades between promotion trigger and shadow window, making the script appear better than warranted. Mitigation: shadow against N_shadow independent fresh model invocations, not the triggering session.

Corpus staleness on environment drift: new OS or API revision invalidates the promotion corpus silently. Mitigation: include environment_schema_hash in regression keys; a hash mismatch on replay triggers re-verification rather than a silent pass.

Demotion race: skill transitions to DEMOTED while an in-flight SHADOW invocation is still executing. Mitigation: state transitions are atomic file-rename operations; in-flight invocations check state at result-write time and discard if DEMOTED.
structured_output.successMetric: After 10 ACTIVE invocations of a promoted skill, divergence_rate versus fresh model output for the same task_type is below 0.05, median wall-clock latency is at least 40% lower than a baseline model call on identical input, and zero regression cases added since promotion have failed their result_schema_hash assertion.
